description: This file contains unit tests for the CanvasActionTrust class, specifically testing the URL trust validation logic for different URLs and scenarios in an Android application.

classes.name: CanvasActionTrustTest
classes.description: Test class for CanvasActionTrust, verifying URL trust logic.

methods.name: acceptsBundledScaffoldAsset
methods.description: Tests that a scaffold asset URL is recognized as trusted.

methods.name: acceptsTrustedA2uiPageOnAdvertisedCanvasHost
methods.description: Ensures that a known good A2UI page URL on a trusted host is accepted.

methods.name: rejectsDifferentOriginEvenIfPathMatches
methods.description: Verifies that URLs from different origins are rejected even if the path matches.

methods.name: rejectsUntrustedCanvasPagePathOnTrustedOrigin
methods.description: Ensures that untrusted page paths are rejected on a trusted origin.

methods.name: acceptsFragmentOnlyDifferenceForTrustedA2uiPage
methods.description: Checks that URLs differing only by fragment are accepted when the base URL is trusted.

methods.name: rejectsQueryMismatchOnTrustedOriginAndPath
methods.description: Verifies that URLs with mismatched query parameters are rejected.

methods.name: rejectsDescendantPathUnderTrustedA2uiRoot
methods.description: Ensures that URLs pointing to child paths under a trusted A2UI URL are rejected if not explicitly trusted.
